results.description:
One reckless night was supposed to help me forget.

My ex-wife's wedding is everywhere. Every headline. Every photo. Every reminder of the life that fell apart.
So I do what any NHL player trying to outrun the past would do—I find the beautiful stranger who makes me forget my own name for one unforgettable night.
Then I walk away.
Until she walks back into my life.
Turns out the woman I can't stop thinking about is my teammate's little sister.
Now she's everywhere. In the stands. At team dinners. Under my skin.
I've spent years convincing myself I don't do relationships. Not after my marriage imploded.
But Maya doesn't settle for half-hearted. She deserves a man who's all in.
The problem?
For the first time in my life...I want to be that man.
Because losing one marriage was enough.
I'm not about to lose the woman who might just be my forever.
